_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

posted.basis: date the college posted the announcement

rules.basis: rules in the TRUST framework, one quoted line each

rule_names.basis: the rules' own names, in the post's order

framework_letters.basis: letters in the framework's name, read from c1, one per rule

town_hall.basis: date of the town hall, the year from the post

town_hall_hours.basis: length of the town hall on the clock

days_post_to_town_hall.basis: days from the post to the town hall

convocation.basis: date of the convocation, the year from the post

convocation_hours.basis: length of the convocation on the clock

days_post_to_convocation.basis: days from the post to the convocation

seminar.basis: date of the seminar, the year from the post

seminar_hours.basis: length of the seminar on the clock

days_post_to_seminar.basis: days from the post to the seminar

public_hours.basis: hours across the three events, on the clock

students.basis: students the college says rely on it each year, more than

existing_documents.basis: documents titled as an acceptable use policy that the AI hub already links

el_paso_grade.basis: grade through which the El Paso ISD draft bars AI for schoolwork

richardson_vote.basis: date the Richardson board is expected to vote, the year from this run's post

sun_elevation.basis: solar elevation in degrees over Travis County at the town hall's start, NOAA equations, one decimal

sun_azimuth_compass.basis: solar azimuth in degrees clockwise from north at the same moment, one decimal

desks_drawn.basis: desks drawn on the count frame, one per 1,000 of the students the college says rely on it each year, floored

desk_scale.basis: students each drawn desk stands for, the drawing's own rule

walk_pavers.basis: pavers in the walk, one per calendar day from the post to the seminar, both ends counted

paver_town_hall.basis: index of the town hall's paver, the post's day being 0

paver_convocation.basis: index of the convocation's paver, the post's day being 0

paver_seminar.basis: index of the seminar's paver, the post's day being 0

clock_minute_deg.basis: minute hand angle clockwise from twelve at the town hall's start

clock_hour_deg.basis: hour hand angle clockwise from twelve at the town hall's start

key_az_engine.basis: the sun's bearing in the engine's frame, 180 minus the compass bearing
